calculators.title: Bending Stress & Beam Calculator
calculators.desc: Drag loads along a beam: shear and moment diagrams, deflection and σ = Mc/I for I-beams, tubes and more.

calculators.title: BMI Calculator for Kids and Teens
calculators.desc: BMI-for-age percentile for ages 2 to 19 on the CDC growth chart.

calculators.title: Compound Interest Calculator
calculators.desc: Grow savings with monthly deposits: year-by-year table and chart, goals, APY and the rule of 72.

calculators.title: Loan Calculator
calculators.desc: Monthly payment, total interest, payoff date and schedule for car, personal and student loans, with extra payments and APR.

calculators.title: Age Calculator
calculators.desc: Exact age in years, months and days, days lived, next birthday, milestones and the age gap between two people.

calculators.title: Fuel Cost Calculator
calculators.desc: What a trip costs in fuel, from distance, L/100 km or mpg and price, split per person, plus EV comparison.

calculators.title: Time Calculator
calculators.desc: Hours between two times, add and subtract time, a timesheet with breaks and decimal hours for payroll.

calculators.title: Tip Calculator
calculators.desc: Tip and split the bill: evenly or by what each person ordered, rounding, and tipping customs by country.

calculators.title: Statistics Calculator
calculators.desc: Mean, median, standard deviation, quartiles, regression, distributions and hypothesis tests, with the working shown.

calculators.title: Mechanics of Materials
calculators.desc: Stress, strain, shear, torsion, Poisson's ratio, thermal stress and 30 materials.

calculators.title: Shear Stress Calculator
calculators.desc: Bolts and pins in single or double shear, punching, and twisted shafts.

calculators.title: Tensile Test Simulator
calculators.desc: Pull a bar until it breaks and watch the stress-strain curve, necking and toughness.

tools.title: Gallery
tools.desc: View the photos and videos in your folders: fast thumbnails, rows, masonry or list, slideshow, zoom, favourites, and video speed 0.25x to 4x with A-B loops. Nothing is uploaded.

tools.title: Spin Simulator
tools.desc: Neutrons that must turn 720° to come back, the Einstein-de Haas effect (flip a magnet, the iron turns) and the Barnett effect (spin iron, it magnetizes).

tools.title: Light & Metamaterials Lab
tools.desc: Negative refraction, the flat and perfect lens, a live Maxwell simulation of a metamaterial, diffraction gratings and ten things light can do.

tools.title: German New Medicine Explorer
tools.desc: Dr. Hamer's two-phase chart with a draggable marker, organs by germ layer and brain relay, a describe-your-symptoms reader, the 5 Biological Laws and a glossary.

tools.title: 3D Studio (3D modeler for 3D printing)
tools.desc: Build 3D models from boxes, cylinders, text and holes, start from templates, check them for 3D printing and export STL or 3MF. Nothing is uploaded.

tools.title: Neuron Simulator
tools.desc: The Hodgkin-Huxley action potential, nerve conduction with myelin and MS, EPSP summation, the neuromuscular junction and a Nernst / Goldman calculator.

tools.title: Heart Simulator
tools.desc: An animated heart synced to a Wiggers diagram, pressure-volume loops with disease presets, an ECG rhythm trainer with calipers and a hemodynamics calculator.

tools.title: Polls
tools.desc: Make a poll in seconds and share one short link: one or several picks, a closing time, live result bars and a pie chart. No sign-up.

tools.title: Stream Chat
tools.desc: Your YouTube, Twitch and Odysee live chats in one window, Super Chats and tips highlighted. Add it to OBS as a chat dock and on-screen overlay.

tools.title: Spreadsheet Viewer (Excel files)
tools.desc: Open .xlsx, .xls, .ods and CSV files, edit cells and formulas, sort and filter, save as .xlsx or CSV. Fast with big files, nothing is uploaded.

tools.title: Video Database
tools.desc: Every MES video since 2011 with its links on YouTube, Hive, 3Speak, Rumble, Odysee, BitChute and Telegram. Search, filter by series or site, sort and share.

tools.title: MES Kids
tools.desc: Talking flashcards for toddlers: animals with real animal sounds, ABC, shapes, colours and counting, with a gentle What’s this? game. Kid-proof full screen, no ads.
